questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some lamps are clocks.

All clocks are books.

Some books are stones.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some lamps are stones.

II. Some books are lamps.

III. Some clocks are stones.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some lamps are clocks.

All clocks are books.

Some books are stones.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7460f8fdcaa21f43ddcd1000e5c47169c896317253120103be0ee1bd6e306400.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some lamps are stones - False (Because, No definite relation given between Stones and Lamps, so it can be possible only).

II. Some books are lamps - True (Because, Those part of Lamps that is Clocks are also Books).

III. Some clocks are stones - False (Because, No definite relation given between Stones and Clocks, so it can be possible only).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: In the expenditure method, GDP ≡ Sum total of all the final _____ received by the firms in the economy.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**expenditures.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The expenditure method** is one of the three ways to **calculate the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of a country**, the other two being the **production method** and the **income method.**
 
• **In the expenditure method**, **GDP is calculated by adding up all the final expenditures** made on goods and services produced within the country's borders. These expenditures could be made by households, businesses, government, or foreigners.
 
• **Final expenditures** refer to the purchases made by the end-users of the goods and services, and not the intermediate purchases made by businesses to produce those goods and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revenue** refers to the **total income earned **by firms in the economy.
 
• **Gross domestic product (GDP)** is the standard measure of the** value of final goods and services produced by a country for a particular time.**
 
• GDP = private consumption + gross investment + government investment + government spending + (exports-imports).
 
• The calculation of GDP can be done on a quarterly, monthly, half-yearly, or annual basis.
 
• There are **3 Methods of GDP Calculation**:

 
• **Income Approach**: we calculate the income earned by all the factors of production in an economy.
 
• **Expenditure Approach**: measures the total expenditure incurred by all entities on goods and services within the domestic boundaries of a country.
 
• **Output (Production) Approach**: measures the monetary or market value of all the goods and services produced within the borders of the country.

x₁ = 24

x₂ = 45

**Concept:**

The formula for direct variation is y = kx,

**Solution:**

Find the constant of variation:

⇒ k = y₁ / x₁ ⇒ k = 16 / 24 = 0.6667

Use k to find y₂ when x₂ = 45: y₂ = k × x₂ 

⇒ y₂ = 0.6667 × 45 = 30

**Hence, y = 30 when x = 45.**

questions.question: If three solid spheres of metal whose radii are 1 cm, 6 cm and 8 cm are melted to form another solid sphere, then the surface area of new sphere (in cm²) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When spheres are melted to form a new sphere, their total volume is conserved.

⇒ R³ = r₁³ + r₂³ + r₃³

⇒ R³ = 1³ + 6³ + 8³ = 1 + 216 + 512 = 729

⇒ R = ³√729 = 9 cm

⇒ Surface Area = 4πR² = 4 × π × 9² = 324π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 324π cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radii of three solid spheres: r₁ = 1 cm, r₂ = 6 cm, r₃ = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Surface Area of a sphere = 4πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52f005c27a1f472d2737d208626fa5272947a26213ca25813e86e280a2b6399f.png] 

**Calculation:**

When melting 3D objects to form a new object, the total volume remains conserved.

⇒ Volume of new sphere = Sum of volumes of three small spheres

⇒ (4/3)πR³ = (4/3)πr₁³ + (4/3)πr₂³ + (4/3)πr₃³

⇒ R³ = r₁³ + r₂³ + r₃³

⇒ R³ = 1³ + 6³ + 8³

⇒ R³ = 1 + 216 + 512

⇒ R³ = 729

⇒ R = ³√729 = 9 cm

Now, substitute the value of R into the surface area formula:

⇒ Surface Area of new sphere = 4 × π × (9)²

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 81 × π

⇒ Surface Area = 324π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 324π cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume Conservation Principle

When any 3D solid is melted and recast into another shape, the total volume of the material remains constant. Thus, Vᵢₙᵢₜᵢₐₗ = Vfᵢₙₐₗ.

Properties of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a full sphere. Its Volume is (2/3)πr³, Curved Surface Area is 2πr², and Total Surface Area is 3πr².

Ratio of Attributes of Spheres

If the ratio of the radii of two spheres is a : b, then the ratio of their surface areas will be a² : b², and the ratio of their volumes will be a³ : b³.

questions.question: The length of a train is 150 metres. In 3 seconds, it passes a man travelling at 2 km/h in the same direction as the train. Determine the train's speed.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 150 ÷ 3 = 50 m/s.

Convert relative speed to km/h: 50 × (18 ÷ 5) = 180 km/h.

Since both are moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = Speed of Train − Speed of Man.

180 = Speed of Train − 2 ⇒ Speed of Train = 182 km/h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the train = 150 m

Time taken to pass the man = 3 s

Speed of the man = 2 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (5 ÷ 18)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52222553a3df02e418574522806da148051b7613e9d8b861bb8a83753fd7d4fa.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the train be v km/h.

⇒ Relative speed of train with respect to the man = (v − 2) km/h

⇒ Convert km/h to m/s = (v − 2) × (5 ÷ 18) m/s

⇒ Distance covered = Length of the train = 150 m

⇒ Time taken = 3 s

⇒ 150 = [(v − 2) × (5 ÷ 18)] × 3

⇒ 150 = (v − 2) × (15 ÷ 18)

⇒ 150 = (v − 2) × (5 ÷ 6)

⇒ v − 2 = 150 × (6 ÷ 5)

⇒ v − 2 = 30 × 6

⇒ v − 2 = 180

⇒ v = 180 + 2

⇒ v = 182 km/h

Relative Speed (Same Direction)

When two objects move in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ − S₂.

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction)

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds: Sᵣₑₗ = S₁ + S₂.
